notes:
Lead: engineering-first startup (developer tools). Primary product: inline PR assistant + IDE plugin that summarizes diffs, suggests review comments, reranks suggested comments by relevance

Key asks / context:
- Extremely latency sensitive: interactive PR review inside IDE (VSCode) — target 95p latency < 120ms for single-file diffs. Streaming preview required for UX.
- Model/version pinning: want ability to pin a stable model for production reviewers; experimental channel for newer models.
- Reranking: need server-side reranker for top-5 suggested comments, custom persona for security-related comments.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-range budget; willing to pay for Dedicated for predictable latency but want Optimize recommendations to reduce token costs.
- Data constraints: customer data (code + internal reviews) cannot leave VPC; must have KMS-managed keys and audit logs.

Call notes (shorthand):
- "If the suggestions are slow, devs will ignore the tool" — head of eng.
- SE asked for streaming token-level previews, partial-comment generation, and ability to attach source spans to suggestions.
- Legal: needs DPA + explicit data residency (US only) and 12-month retention cap.

POC success criteria (customer):
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end <120ms for single-file diffs, <250ms for multi-file aggregations.
- Throughput: sustain 200 concurrent reviewer sessions per cluster.
- Accuracy: reviewer-accept rate of generated comments >= 40% on internal eval set.
- Cost: per-comment token spend < $0.0007 average.

Stated blockers: legal still reviewing DPA; SSO test account not yet provided; internal procurement requires 2 exec approvals.

Next steps captured in CRM: finish POC plan (SE), schedule SSO test window (CSM), legal follow-up (AE).
